_note: MediBill Jira history, seeded with: node demo/seed-jira.mjs --app medibill. Keys CUP_BIL-3xx are placeholders, mapped to the real keys in demo/jira-keys.json (CUP_DEMO-… and CUP_LAB-… refer to MediAgenda and MediLab tickets). Oldest first.

issues.summary: [BE] - Tariffario: regional fee schedule for the services we charge
issues.description: The billing office charges the co-pay of visits and tests at the regional tariff. Each visit tariff belongs to a MediAgenda provider (resource code), so the visits can be charged automatically.

comments.body: GET /api/tariffs, Flyway V1: six visit tariffs mapped to the MediAgenda providers (tariffs.mediagenda_resource).

issues.description: Angular app with the layout of the suite and the Tariffario page.

comments.body: Done; amounts with shared/utils/money.ts (formatMoney).

issues.summary: [BE][FE] - Esenzioni: co-pay exemptions of the patients
issues.description: Register the exemptions of MediAgenda patients: total ones (income, age, oncology) and disease ones (e.g. 013 diabetes: glucose, HbA1c and the eye visit are free), each with its validity.

comments.body: POST /api/exemptions (patient read from MediAgenda), Flyway V2, ExemptionType with the covered tariff codes.
Esenzioni page. The patient picker is the one of MediLab (shared/components/patient-picker).

issues.summary: [BE][FE] - Import addebiti: the MediAgenda visits of a day
issues.description: Every morning the office charges the visits of the day before. Read the bookings from MediAgenda and charge each visit of the chosen day at the tariff of its provider.

comments.body: ChargeImportService over MediAgenda's GET /api/bookings (the BookingView I know from DEM: appointmentAt, resourceCode, fiscalCode). Every booking with its appointment on the day is a visit to charge; MediAgenda bookings are CONFERMATA or COMPLETATA. Flyway V3.
Addebiti page: day picker with Ieri/Oggi, open charges by patient.

issues.summary: [BE] - Import addebiti: importing a day twice charges the visits twice
issues.description: On Monday the import of Friday was started twice (the first one seemed stuck). All Friday visits are now charged twice.

comments.body: Each charge remembers its source (booking id); a booking charged already is counted as "già presente" and not charged again (existsBySourceAndSourceRef).

issues.summary: [FE] - Addebiti: "Ieri" imports the day before yesterday
issues.description: The night operator clicks Ieri at 00:40 and the import is for the day before yesterday.

comments.body: toISOString() is UTC: just after midnight it is still the day before in UTC. shared/utils/dates.ts localIsoDate() uses the local day.

issues.summary: [BE][FE] - Ricevute: receipts with co-pay and exemptions
issues.description: Issue one receipt for the open charges of a patient: services covered by an exemption are free, the co-pay is at most 36,15 €. The receipt is paid at the desk; an unpaid receipt can be cancelled to correct it.

comments.body: ReceiptService (co-pay, exemptions), Flyway V4. Ricevute page and EMETTI RICEVUTA on Addebiti by Chiara.

issues.summary: [BE] - Ricevute: co-pay above 36,15 € with two visits
issues.description: Fontana Chiara, two visits on the same day: the receipt asks 45,00 €. The co-pay of a receipt should never be above 36,15 €.

comments.body: The cap was applied to each service and the lines added up. It is applied to the receipt now.

issues.description: The Ricevute page shows 22.5 and 15.49 instead of 22,50 € and 15,49 €.

comments.body: The page printed the raw numbers; it uses formatMoney like the other pages now.

issues.summary: [BE] - Ricevute: an expired exemption still makes the visit free
issues.description: Bianchi Laura's E02 exemption ended on 30/06, but her August visit was still charged 0 €.

comments.body: ExemptionService.validOn returned every exemption of the patient; it keeps only those valid on the day of the service now.

issues.summary: [BE] - Import addebiti: the tests reported in MediLab
issues.description: Charge the laboratory tests as well: every day the requests reported in MediLab, one charge per test at its tariff.

comments.body: MediLabClient over GET /api/orders?status=REFERTATA&from=&to= (CUP_LAB-116 in MediLab, thanks Alessandro). Lab tariffs in Flyway V5.

issues.description: Rossi Mario, three tests of 1,13 €: the receipt PDF shows a co-pay of 3,3899999999999997 € and the cash register refuses it.

comments.body: The sums were computed in double. ReceiptService uses BigDecimal throughout now.

issues.summary: [BE] - Import addebiti: error 500 when a test has no tariff
issues.description: The import of 25/09 fails with "Errore 500": nothing was imported for that day, not even the visits.

comments.body: A new MediLab test (vitamin D, 90.99.9) is not in our fee schedule yet; findById(...).orElseThrow() ended the import. Such tests are skipped and listed under "skipped" now.

issues.summary: [BE] - Ricevute: a paid receipt can be cancelled
issues.description: A paid receipt was cancelled by mistake: its charges went back to Addebiti and the patient got a second receipt.

comments.body: Receipt.storno() requires EMESSA now (409 otherwise).

issues.summary: [BE][FE] - Report incassi: receipts and co-pay of a month
issues.description: The administration needs the monthly figures: receipts, amount at tariff, exempt part, co-pay issued and collected.

comments.body: GET /api/reports/monthly?month=yyyy-MM; Report incassi page by Chiara.

issues.summary: [BE] - Report incassi: cancelled receipts are counted
issues.description: October shows 3 receipts and 60,49 € of co-pay; the cash register says 37,99 €. One receipt was cancelled.

comments.body: STORNATA receipts are left out of the report now.

issues.summary: [FE] - Esenzioni: the exemption is saved for the previously picked patient
issues.description: I picked Bianchi by mistake, typed Ricci and saved: the exemption went to Bianchi Laura.

comments.body: We copied the patient picker from MediLab before their fix CUP_LAB-119 (same symptom). Same fix: onInput() forgets the picked patient as soon as the text is edited.

issues.summary: [FE] - Report incassi opens on the previous month
issues.description: Today (2 November) Report incassi opens on ottobre 2026.

comments.body: monthOf() used getMonth(), which counts from 0. Fixed (+1).
